content: The Delhi Police have stepped up monitoring of social media platforms ahead of the event, with public posts being tracked for possible security threats and misinformation

title: Power crisis: Keralam CM chairs emergency meeting, issues directive for immediate measures
content: KSEB chairperson and managing director says the board will expand the system used to notify consumers in advance about power restrictions. He says State’s peak demand touched a record 5,400 MW on Thursday, whereas it recorded a lower average demand of 4,224 MW in September last year

title: Inspections in multiplexes in Keralam to continue
content: Food and Civil Supplies Minister announced ongoing inspections at multiplexes to combat the persistent issue of food overpricing and inaccurate quantities. Following numerous complaints, State authorities have conducted 35 surprise inspections, resulting in 25 cases registered for violations.

title: Cybercrime police bring impersonation fraud accused on PT warrant from Punjab to Hyderabad
content: Police said investigation indicated that the accused had duped 14 victims across various States to the tune of ₹3 crore in cash and gold ornaments. No money was lost by the complainant in the Hyderabad case

content: High Court dismisses two petitions filed by competitors challenging the award of the bid to Edifice Engineering.

content: PM Modi accepts President Putin invite for the 24th India-Russia Annual Summit in Moscow later this year

content: Upputholla Mallesh wanted to continue service but was given premature retirement on June 30 after he suffered a ligament tear

title: Exam irregularities: Kerala PSC chairperson, members decline Crime Branch summons, seek questioning at Commission headquarters
content: The special investigation team seeks to question the PSC functionaries in connection with the alleged discrepancies in examinations conducted for senior posts in the Kerala State Planning Board

title: Tharoor answers Chidambaram’s questions on Brics benefits for India; BJP takes digs
content: Shashi Tharoor defended India's BRICS summit prestige in contrast to Chidambaram's questions on its tangible benefits. The BJP criticized Chidambaram's remarks and highlighted Tharoor's differing viewpoint. Tharoor stated hosting leaders shows diplomatic convening power and value. He also noted BRICS represents a majority of the world's population. Tharoor's independent views often create internal Congress party discussions.

title: Houthi advances puts India and global trade closer to the edge
content: Houthi forces are close to seizing control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, crucial for global shipping. This advance heightens concerns over trade security and energy supply chains around the world. India could experience rising costs and extended transit times for its goods. The Houthis are also enhancing their military capabilities, including integrating AI into weapons systems. This development poses new geopolitical challenges, especially for Pakistan and its defense alliances.

title: 2 buyers paid Rs 1.16cr, got no flats; RERA orders builder to refund with interest
content: The Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority has directed the developer to refund the amounts paid, along with applicable interest, after noting that the project remained incomplete and its registration had lapsed without an extension.

title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
content: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: Mumbai mall entry case: Man used ChatGPT to create fake PMO docs, police tell court
content: A 24-year-old man was arrested for impersonating a PMO official at Jio World Plaza. He allegedly used ChatGPT to create fake PMO documents and an identity card. Police seized electronic devices and documents from his residence in Khar. His private security guard, an ex-Army personnel, was also arrested with a firearm. Both accused have been remanded to judicial custody by the court.

title: In Noida’s PG belt, buildings rise nine floors where two are allowed
content: Densely packed multi-storey paying guest accommodations have been built illegally in Noida villages. These structures often lack essential fire safety and emergency exits, posing significant risks. Many buildings violate building codes, with thin columns and narrow lanes hindering access for emergency services. Demand for affordable housing from students and IT professionals drives this rampant, unsafe construction. Tenants prioritize affordability over documented safety measures in their accommodation choices.

title: Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India
content: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have officially launched worldwide.  These devices feature the powerful A20 Pro chip and improved camera technology.  Pricing for these flagship iPhones varies considerably across different countries.  The United States offers the most affordable purchase option for both models.  India's pricing reflects higher local taxes and import duties on electronics.

title: Instead of managing billions, Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett chose farming
content: Choosing a path less traveled, Howard Buffett, the son of Warren Buffett, dedicated his life to farming and conservation rather than finance. He skillfully managed farms in Nebraska and Illinois, prioritizing soil health. Warren Buffett supported his passion by purchasing a Nebraska farm for his son. As he transitions to the role of non-executive chairman at Berkshire Hathaway, Howard aims to safeguard the company’s culture following his father's legacy.

title: UK police uncover £1.3 million cannabis factory inside abandoned BHS store
content: Thames Valley Police uncovered a £1.3 million cannabis factory inside a disused BHS store in Slough, finding more than 1,700 plants across two floors. The crop had a potential yield of 150.27kg and an estimated street value of £1.288 million. Two men pleaded guilty and were sentenced to 14 months in prison.

title: Microsoft signs 'iron-clad' student privacy deal with teachers unions after NYC AI ban
content: Microsoft has signed a legally binding AI privacy agreement with the American Federation of Teachers and United Federation of Teachers, a week after Zohran Mamdani banned AI in NYC schools. The standard bars Microsoft from training AI on student data, tracking students or offering AI companion chatbots. School districts can cancel contracts over violations. Los Angeles Unified has paused student AI use, while unions want OpenAI and Anthropic to sign next.

title: Max Thieriot turned 90-acre Sonoma ranch into vineyard, farm and retreat
content: Max Thieriot’s roughly 90-acre Sonoma County ranch has evolved since he and his wife Lexi bought it in 2013. The property now includes the nine-acre Bodega Thieriot Pinot noir vineyard, while the rest remains hillside, woodland and pasture. Though the actor’s family now lives in Washington state for most of the year, he continues returning to the ranch during the off-season.

title: Lessons from Ukraine war: Poland wants its own Starlink; where does India stand?
content: Poland is set to collaborate with Finnish firm ICEYE to establish a new military satellite communications system, aiming to lessen its dependency on foreign entities for vital battlefield communications. This project is projected to unfold between 2026 and 2030, incorporating local industrial partners. Meanwhile, India has had robust military satellite communication capabilities for over ten years, recently enhancing its maritime surveillance with the launch of CMS-03.

title: 'We will never, ever forget': Trump commemorates 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
content: On the anniversary of 9/11, leaders across the United States honored the victims and reflected on the impact of the tragedy on current foreign policy. Speaking at the Pentagon, President Trump paid homage to the fallen and reaffirmed the nation’s determination, particularly in its dealings with Iran. Defense Secretary Hegseth reinforced this message, relating the historical attacks to the ongoing war on terror.

title: ‘His time will come’: Rahane wants Sooryavanshi to wait as Samson returns
content: Ajinkya Rahane expresses his enthusiastic support for Sanju Samson's reentry into India's batting lineup, asserting the importance of maintaining their World Cup-winning squad for the upcoming Afghanistan series. In a recent video, Rahane encouraged young talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to trust in his instincts and play freely, while highlighting the need for mental resilience to bolster his career growth.

title: Paige Bueckers vs Azzi Fudd net worth: Who is richer in 2026?
content: Paige Bueckers and Azzi Fudd have built significant wealth through college NIL deals.  Bueckers' WNBA rookie contract was worth over $300,000.  Fudd secured a historic rookie deal starting at $500,000.  Their combined net worth is estimated between $3 and $3.5 million.  This figure is expected to rise sharply as their careers progress.

title: Connor Hellebuyck trade: Did Olympic fallout involving his wife push him out?
content: The trade request by Winnipeg Jets goaltender Connor Hellebuyck has re-emerged as a topic of conversation following the backlash his wife Andrea received after Team USA’s Olympic victory and White House visit. The controversy adds further personal pressure on the player at an already difficult time, although Hellebuyck has not stated the treatment of his family as the sole reason for his decision.

title: Days before 9/11, businessman took Twin Towers' lease; now, the rebuilding nears end
content: The final commercial office tower at the World Trade Center site is actively being built as the new global headquarters for American Express. This project has emerged after extensive planning and has navigated numerous hurdles. It acts as a tribute to the lives lost and rekindles commercial activity in Lower Manhattan, representing a crucial milestone in the comprehensive post-9/11 redevelopment plan.

title: UP man stalks, stabs teen in neck after she rejects his advances; arrested
content: An Agra man was arrested after stabbing a nineteen-year-old woman. He attacked her on her way to work after she rejected his advances. The woman was rushed to a hospital for treatment of her wounds. Police apprehended the accused near the JCB Ground after receiving information. The sharp object used in the crime was reportedly thrown into a river.

title: 20 runs in 6 innings: Pak openers register worst Test series in 35 years vs England
content: In a dismal display, Pakistan's opening batsmen faltered throughout their recent Test series against England, accumulating a mere twenty runs across six partnerships. This represented the team's worst performance in thirty-five years, with no partnership exceeding ten runs. Despite the collective shortcomings, Azan Awais managed to find some consistency, although his partners repeatedly fell victim to batting collapses, highlighted by a first innings disaster at Edgbaston.

title: Disha Salian’s father accuses Aaditya Thackeray, actor Dino Morea of her death
content: Disha Salian's father provided a statement to the CBI regarding her death.  He has accused Shiv Sena UBT leader Aditya Thackeray and actor Dino Morea.  The CBI is now investigating the case after a Bombay High Court order.  Previously, Mumbai police concluded Disha Salian died by suicide in 2020.  Her father petitioned the court alleging suspicious circumstances surrounding her demise.

title: Watch: Putin takes swipe at 'so called' G7, says Brics accounts for over 40% of world GDP
content: At the Brics Business Forum, Russian President Vladimir Putin emphasized the growing influence of Brics, which now represents over forty percent of global GDP, outpacing the G7's twenty-nine percent contribution. He pointed out that these statistics illustrate the ongoing transformation of the global economic order. Furthermore, Putin and Prime Minister Modi participated in significant bilateral talks to strengthen ties.

title: 'Trade barriers rising globally, India building bridges': PM Modi at Brics forum
content: "Today, while trade barriers are rising globally, India is building economic bridges. Since 2014, we have entered into free trade agreements with nearly 40 countries," PM Modi said.

title: Rohit Roy slams TV actors, calls TV a ‘dustbin medium’, says many 'lack class, grace'
content: Rohit Roy expressed his belief that television actors often lack sophistication and elegance, labeling the medium as a 'dustbin' for its perceived low status. He emphasized that film actors exude a certain style and presence in public. According to Roy, the popularity generated on social media doesn’t translate to real respect for actors. Ultimately, he feels that cinema will always be regarded as superior to television in terms of legacy.

title: Bumrah bowls in full-squad practice as India step up Afghan T20I preparations
content: Jasprit Bumrah joined India’s full-squad training session ahead of their three-match T20I series against Afghanistan. The players went through warm-ups, fielding drills and an extended net session. Ishan Kishan briefly raised concerns after going down, but later walked off without apparent discomfort.

title: 'Still have curfew?': Warner takes dig at Barmy Army, fans hit back with 'Broad' meme
content: David Warner playfully engaged with the Barmy Army on social media, starting with light-hearted jabs at Saim Ayub's batting performance. He cheekily mentioned Marnus Labuschagne's ongoing century drought and poked fun at England's curfew struggles. The Barmy Army quickly fired back by highlighting Warner's past difficulties against Stuart Broad, to which Warner humorously suggested they need to find a fresh target.

title: India's forex reserves surge record $44.9 billion to all-time high of $785.7 billion
content: India has achieved a remarkable milestone with its foreign exchange reserves soaring to an impressive $785.706 billion. This upswing comes on the heels of a notable rise in the previous week, primarily fueled by robust foreign currency assets. The central bank's proactive steps attracted more than USD 136 billion in fresh inflows. Conversely, there was a slight dip in the value of India's gold reserves during that period.

title: Nezam Hafiz faced Brian Lara in 1988; 13 years later, he lost his life in 9/11 attacks
content: Nezam Hafiz, a talented cricketer originally from Guyana, lost his life in the tragic World Trade Center attacks. After relocating to the U.S., he proudly represented the American cricket team. In his honor, teammates organized memorial cricket events in New York, which persisted for years following the September 11 tragedy. A bat used during these heartfelt matches now resides in a museum, serving as a poignant reminder of his legacy.

title: Russia unveils new S-71K stealth missile for Su-57E amid potential sale to India
content: Russia has disclosed its latest S-71K Kovyor air-launched weapon designed specifically for the Su-57E fighter jet. This advanced system integrates the capabilities of both cruise missiles and drones, enabling effective stand-off attacks. With enhanced stealth features and cost-effectiveness for broader operational deployment, Russia is actively engaging India in discussions about potential joint production and technology transfer related to the Su-57E and its cutting-edge armaments.

title: PM Modi, Putin share car ride in Delhi, weeks after traveling together in Bishkek - watch
content: During an informal car ride in Delhi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin rekindled their camaraderie, continuing their tradition of traveling together. This ride marks their fourth time sharing a vehicle, following earlier occasions in Bishkek and Tianjin. Their private talks during the journey underscore the depth of their diplomatic ties and mutual understanding.

title: ‘He rejected it’: Ex-PCB selector blames Imran Khan for Pakistan cricket’s downfall
content: Former chief selector of Pakistan cricket, Haroon Rasheed, identifies the setbacks in the sport to Imran Khan's reforms. Rasheed highlighted that Khan dismissed a hybrid model for the domestic cricket structure, significantly diminishing the first-class teams in Pakistan. He pointed out that India's layered domestic system promotes talent depth, advocating for Pakistan to decentralise its cricket governance to enhance the game.

title: Putin brings 'Flying Kremlin' to India for Brics: What makes 'Doomsday Plane' different?
content: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in New Delhi for a summit and bilateral talks. He traveled on a specially modified Ilyushin IL-96-300PU aircraft for security. This aircraft functions as a mobile command center with advanced communication systems. The United States operates comparable aircraft for its own national command needs. These planes are designed for survivability during national emergencies and conflicts.

title: 'I don't want to be murdered by a Chinese robot'
content: Hopefully, whatever version of doomsday the AI world is worried about waits until after Avengers: Doomsday, because after all the multiverse nonsense and speculation about how Robert Downey Jr is going to return to the MCU as Doctor Doom, one really wants to watch Kevin Feige explain that before artificial intelligence kills everyone.

title: 112 years later! Robinson enters rarest Test bowling club with sub-19 average
content: In a remarkable feat, Ollie Robinson has achieved a bowling average of under nineteen after his 20th match, making him the first bowler to do so since the iconic Sydney Barnes in 1914. With two crucial wickets during Pakistan's second innings at Edgbaston, Robinson joins a select group of five bowlers with this outstanding record, positioning himself among the top wicket-takers in cricket history.

title: Putin invites PM Modi to Russia for 24th annual summit - key points from Brics summit
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Russian President Vladimir Putin during the summit.  Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian also arrived for discussions with PM Modi.  Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected for bilateral talks and the summit.  The expanded Brics grouping focuses on development and cooperation among emerging economies.  India hosts the summit under its theme of resilience and innovation.

title: France sends Rafales on 40,000-km global mission to project power from Arctic to Indo-Pacific
content: The Pegase 26 mission from France brings Rafale jets into action as they journey 40,000 kilometers across three continents. This ambitious undertaking not only demonstrates France's skills in executing swift long-distance operations but also enhances collaborative capabilities with partners through essential aerial refueling. Taking an innovative northern route crossing the Arctic, the mission underscores France's strategic prominence and dedication to bolstering global security relationships.

title: Bihar’s Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata scheme: Rs 60,000 aid for landless families; key provisions explained
content: The Mukhyamantri Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata Yojana in Bihar is designed to assist landless families by providing Rs 60,000. This financial aid is specifically for those eligible for the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin to buy residential plots. The program is aimed at villages lacking government land for housing, ensuring funds are directly deposited into beneficiaries' bank accounts after thorough verification.

title: After Pakistan's cybercrime summons, Rizwan & Imam face domestic cricket setback
content: Following their recent tour in England, Pakistani cricketers Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq find themselves under scrutiny due to a cybercrime investigation triggered by evidence from their mobile phones. As a result of their inability to meet fitness requirements, both players will miss the opening round of the President's Trophy Grade-I, amid the aftermath of a challenging tour filled with recalls.

title: PM Modi's special gift to Putin comes with a Tamil connection
content: During a significant meeting ahead of the BRICS Summit, Prime Minister Modi gifted President Putin a translated version of the ancient Tamil text, Thirukkural, by Naira Mkrtchyan. Both leaders held bilateral talks on the sidelines of the Brics summit being held in New Delhi.

content: Speaking at the BRICS Business Forum here, Piyush Goyal also said the share of BRICS nations in global exports has nearly doubled to about 24 per cent.

content: Putin's visit comes amid continued high-level engagement between New Delhi and Moscow and follows his meeting with PM Modi on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek last week.

content: Trump rejected the request, and US officials said the administration does not intend to take direct military action against the Houthis at this time

content: Himanta Sarma said BRICS has a historic responsibility to promote global peace and prosperity amid the prevailing international crisis.
